title: Data Bazaar
tagline: a community forum allows anyone to track popular content just like Hacker.
description:
DATA BAZAAR IS A COMMUNITY FORUM ALLOWS ANYONE TO TRACK POPULAR CONTENT JUST LIKE HACKER NEWS.

ANYONE CAN POST AN ENTRY TO DATA BAZAAR. UPVOTING THE CONTENT REQUIRES YOU TO ATTACH NEAR. 

* Sign in with NEAR Testnet and add a message to the Data Bazaar forum.

* A starter app built with an AssemblyScript backend and a React frontend.
